title: Messaging between agent sessions
requirement: Let concurrent agent sessions of both coding agents on one host exchange messages and hand work to each other, or establish that the clients' native facilities cover it.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Delivery and ordering of messages between a Claude Code session and a Codex session, behaviour when the receiver is busy or gone, and setup effort.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
